c0.title: SIDE-kernel: Lean 4 formalization of the SIDE reduction of the Riemann Hypothesis by mechanism exclusion

plan.start: the programme's standing reduction is Weil positivity on classK
plan.old: the programme's standing reduction is Weil positivity on classK, equivalent to RH on the kernel's zero configuration, compiled both ways in SIDE-explicit-formula v0.1.
plan.new: the programme's standing reduction is Weil positivity on classK, equivalent to RH on the kernel's zero configuration, compiled both ways in SIDE-explicit-formula v0.1. Li's criterion is compiled over Mathlib's zeros as a two-way equivalence in the programme's kernel (li_nonneg_iff_rh, v0.9), its converse vendored from nicholasbulka/li-criterion-rh-equivalence-lean at 35df682f under Apache 2.0; equivalently, RH is the nonnegativity of the Bombieri–Lagarias arithmetic limits (arith_limit_nonneg_iff_rh). Weil positivity on classK, Li positivity and arithmetic-limit positivity are compiled as equivalent faces of the one open clause. The criterion for primitive χ is composed: Weil positivity on classK for χ ⟺ GRH_chi, both directions compiled (h2_sign_chi_iff_grh_chi, v0.14), the converse by the ζ route over the χ-configuration with its own local count. The one clause now has two compiled instances, ζ and primitive χ ≠ 1, each equivalent to the location of its own zeros; neither is proved.
